try { var r = jget('https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD').rates; return '1 USD = ' + r.EUR + ' EUR / ' + r.GBP + ' GBP'; } catch (e) { return 'offline'; }

try { var w = String(input || '').trim(); if (!w) return 'select a word first'; var d = jget('https://api.dictionaryapi.dev/api/v2/entries/en/' + encodeURIComponent(w)); return w + ': ' + d[0].meanings[0].definitions[0].definition; } catch (e) { return 'no definition'; }

try { var u = String(input || '').trim(); if (!u) return 'select a username first'; var g = jget('https://api.github.com/users/' + encodeURIComponent(u)); return (g.name || u) + ' — ' + g.public_repos + ' repos, ' + g.followers + ' followers'; } catch (e) { return 'user not found'; }
